leadText:
----
 
Let's Gather Nice-to-Meet-Yous. (Japanese: はじめまして、をあつめよう。 Hajimemashite, o Atsumeyō.) is the theme song of monpoké Short Animation.

The title of the song is the same as the monpoké brand slogan. The music video for the song was released on the Japanese Pokémon Kids TV YouTube channel on December 18, 2024.
plainText:
----
 
Let's Gather Nice-to-Meet-Yous. (Japanese: はじめまして、をあつめよう。 Hajimemashite, o Atsumeyō.) is the theme song of monpoké Short Animation.

The title of the song is the same as the monpoké brand slogan. The music video for the song was released on the Japanese Pokémon Kids TV YouTube channel on December 18, 2024.

==Lyrics==
===TV size===
 
! Japanese
! Rōmaji
! English

このうみのはての　そのむこうに　
きみだけのちずを　えがいてさ
はじめましてを　あつめよう 

Kono umi no hate no sono mukō ni
Kimi dake no chizu o egaite sa
Hajimemashite o atsumeyō 

Beyond the edge of this sea
Drawing a map just for you
Let's gather nice-to-meet-yous 

===Full version===
 
! Japanese
! Rōmaji
! English

イロんななかまが　まっている
ゆうきをだして　はじめまして 
みんなえがおは　おんなじだ

さびしいときには　ほしをみようよ
よるがあけたら　たいようにあえる
おはよう　こんにちは　はじめまして
てをつないで　とびだせば　どこにでもゆける

さあ　あたらしいせかいにいこう　
このうみのはての　そのむこうに　
きみだけのちずを　えがいてさ
はじめましてを　あつめよう

このまぶしくて　おおきなあおぞらに
はじめましてと　おおきくさけぼう
いっしょにたのしく　うたったら
みんなのこころに　にじがでる

かなしいときには　ないたらいいさ
ポケットのなかに　なみだしまって
ぼくらは　きっともう　ひとりじゃないよ
なかまと　たすけあえば　なんでもできる

さあ　いっしょにぼうけんにでよう
ドキドキワクワク　あふれている
ちいさないっぽで　いいんだよ
はじめましてが　まっている

そう　ありのままのきみがいいよ
ぼくもきみもみんな　かがやいてる
わくわくなであい　ありがとう
はじめまして　をあつめよう

はじめまして　をあつめよう 

Ironna nakama ga matteiru
Yūki o dashite hajimemashite
Minna egao wa onnaji da

Sabishii toki ni wa hoshi o miyō yo
Yoru ga aketara taiyō ni aeru
Ohayō konnichiwa hajimemashite
Te o tsunaide tobidaseba doko ni demo yukeru

Sā atarashii sekai ni ikō
Kono umi no hate no sono mukō ni
Kimi dake no chizu o egaite sa
Hajimemashite o atsumeyō

Kono mabushikute ōkina aozora ni
Hajimemashite to ōkiku sakebō
Issho ni tanoshiku utattara
Minna no kokoro ni niji ga deru

Kanashii toki ni wa naitara ii sa
Poketto no naka ni namida shimatte
Bokura wa kitto mō hitori janai yo
Nakama to tasukeaeba nandemo dekiru

Sā issho ni bōken ni deyō
Dokidoki wakuwaku afureteiru
Chiisana ippo de iinda yo
Hajimemashite ga matteiru

Sō ari no mama no kimi ga ii yo
Boku mo kimi mo minna kagayaiteru
Wakuwaku na deai arigatō
Hajimemashite o atsumeyō

Hajimemashite o atsumeyō 

In this big, wide world
Summon up the courage to greet them 
Everyone is sharing smiles

Look up to the stars when you feel lonely
When the night fades, you'll see the sun
Good morning, hello, nice to meet you
If we hold hands as we take off, we can go anywhere

Let's head out into the new world　
Beyond the edge of this sea
Drawing a map just for you
Let's gather nice-to-meet-yous

Let's shout out "nice to meet you"
To the dazzling, vast blue sky
If we sing happily together
A rainbow will appear in everyone's hearts

It's alright to cry when you feel sad
Storing those tears in the pocket
We're definitely not alone anymore
If we help each other, we can do anything 

Come on, let's go on an adventure together
I'm overflowing with excitement
It's fine to take just one small step
Everyone's looking forward to meet you

Yeah, you're fine just the way you are
You and I and everyone are shining
Thank you for the exciting meeting
Let's gather nice-to-meet-yous

Let's gather nice-to-meet-yous 

==Video==
 

 

 

zh:初次见面，来相聚吧。
